fields.quoted_span:
A landlord cannot take reprisal action against a tenant by eviction, substantial alteration of 
a lease or its terms, or refusal to renew a lease when a tenant exercises certain civil rights (N.J.S.A. 
2A:42-10.10).
fields.note: The four protected rights and the right to sue for damages are all in the document's Reprisal section. The record paraphrases them accurately, including the written-notice precondition for good-faith complaints.
key_value is null. The reprisal section sets no numeric or other key value.
effective_date is null and the document gives no effective date for the reprisal law.

fields.quoted_span:
The law against reprisal applies to all rental properties used for dwelling purposes, 
including mobile homes, except owner-occupied two- or three-family dwellings.
fields.note: The summary, the owner-occupied exemption and the max of 3 units all match this sentence.
The document cites N.J.S.A. 2A:42-10.10 for the reprisal provision. The alias 'Reprisal law' is only a descriptive label.
